responsibility: Application lifecycle facade, headless frame pumping, deterministic application trace, composition wiring, and backend-neutral platform ports beginning with monotonic time.

lifetime.scope: one App instance plus caller-owned platform port objects
lifetime.creation: App::Init creates ApplicationRuntime through the explicit composition root; CreateMonotonicTimeSource creates a caller-owned time source
lifetime.shutdown: Quit is a request; Stopped is reached at a frame boundary or explicit runtime shutdown; caller-owned time sources are released by RAII

threading.affinity: application owner thread for App; current time-port consumers use their owning caller thread
threading.concurrency: Run owns the loop while active; PumpFrame is rejected during Run; the time port exposes no mutable state or cross-thread callback route

invariants.text: App initializes without SDL, Vulkan, ImGui, APaint, scene, or game dependencies.
Quit is a request and becomes Stopped only at the canonical safe frame boundary.
PumpFrame cannot execute while Run owns the application loop.
Headless manual pumping produces deterministic frame and lifecycle trace ordering through the public SDK.
The public time port is backend-neutral and the production monotonic adapter never reports time moving backwards for sequential samples.
